title: Skipframe Circuit
generation_prompt: Original upbeat all-ages liquid drum-and-bass instrumental for a one-or-two-key electronic rhythm game at a STRICT constant 170 BPM in 4/4. Start with the full drum grid on the FIRST SECOND and keep it audible through the final bar: crisp kick on beats one and three, short clear snare on two and four, closed eighth-note hats and small syncopated woodblock or muted-key taps between the snares. Every two-bar phrase needs at least eight distinct short midrange transients, including the quieter middle. No tempo drift, half-time section, beatless intro, drum dropout, free-time break or smeared pad-only bridge. Signature hook: two low plucked-synth notes a fifth apart, answered one eighth-note later by a quick three-note descending bell phrase with the last note cut short. Repeat the call-and-answer with changing chord roots; at the midpoint keep the same uninterrupted two-step beat, invert the bell phrase upward and pass its rhythm to a brighter marimba-like sound. The ending interleaves the low call with the inverted answer in a new cadence instead of duplicating the opening. Use a light rolling bass, airy chords kept behind the beat, stereo detail and clean transient separation. One evolving 128-second instrumental; playful momentum without abrasive distortion. No vocals, speech, sampled recordings, known melody or imitation of an existing song.
cover_prompt: Create a brand-new SQUARE 1:1 original album cover for duohertz track Skipframe Circuit, an all-ages drum-and-bass rhythm-game song. High-contrast original editorial comic-print collage on a near-black ink field with warm-ivory paper, electric-cyan light and one restrained coral accent. Main motif: three BIG independent warm-ivory rectangular paper frames floating diagonally upward, each offset a little from the previous one as though a moving image skipped forward; a single cyan zigzag pulse passes through their open centers without forming a road or a screen. A small coral square marks the final syncopated beat. Give the frames visibly different spacing, generous negative space and a bold silhouette readable at 100px. Reserve calm dark space along the lower fifth for a local title overlay. Sparse print halftone only. No characters, vehicles, computer monitor, film strip, arrows, stairs, domino pieces, rings, text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark or copied game art.
og_prompt: Edit the supplied original Skipframe Circuit square cover into a HORIZONTAL 1.9:1 duohertz social-sharing card. Preserve the three separate warm-ivory open rectangular paper frames stepping diagonally upward, the single cyan zigzag pulse crossing their centers and one small coral square on a near-black comic-print background. Recompose the motif on the RIGHT two-thirds, with quiet dark space on the LEFT. Add exactly two crisp legible English lines on the left: 'duohertz' in lowercase electric cyan and 'Skipframe Circuit' in larger warm ivory. Spell both exactly. Make a purpose-built wide composition, not a stretched square crop. No other text, letters, numbers, characters, roads, vehicles, screens, film strips, logos, watermark or copied game art.
